name: TAIWAN VIX source-quality and liquidity dependency contract
findings: TAIWAN VIX is calculated from TAIEX option quotes and measures 30-day expected TAIEX volatility; it is not a directional forecast.
TAIFEX publishes the index every 15 seconds during 09:00-13:45 regular trading, so same-session VIX is known before an 18:10 after-market decision if a timestamped official receipt is preserved.
TAIFEX public site exposes current-month and recent intraday/daily history, while official e-data shop offers longer historical data from 2007 under paid single-person/single-machine terms.
Because VIX is quote-derived, option quote quality/liquidity is an upstream measurement dependency, not merely a separate explanatory factor.

Friday-expiry TXO introduced in 2025 changes the option expiry ecosystem; methodology may target a 30-day horizon, but source-composition/quote-quality diagnostics must still version market-structure regimes rather than assume invariant microstructure.

liquidityDependency.guard: Do not reconstruct historical intraday VIX quote quality from daily chain fields.

redundancyOrder: VIX minus expected future realized variance only under a frozen VRP design

maturityDecision.next: L3 only after PIT source receipt semantics plus Taiwan-date evidence are demonstrated
maturityDecision.reason: Official source/timing and quality dependency are now frozen, but prospective/OOS evidence is still absent.
